name: Zulai, Areni
review: It reminded me of a Pinot Noir, but kind of spicy - notes of cherry, blackberry, and pepper. A little earthy as well. This was a dark red, ruby wine.

name: Clay Shannon, Cabernet Sauvignon
review: Oak, tobacco, dark fruit notes, sort of dry medium acidity, not really smooth or tannic. Very very good wine, I was happy with this bottle.

name: Shaya, Blanco
review: Very good Spanish white wine. Fruit forward with an alcoholic taste.

name: Hunky Dory, Sauvignon Blanc
review: Crisp, dry white wine. Very acidic, with a tropical fruity flavor.

name: Domino de Punctum, Lobetia Tempranillo
review: Solid wine, organic, cheap ($10.99) and had a pretty label.

name: Domaine Lafage, Cote Est Blanc
review: Crisp, green apple, and light. Dry wine, with a lemon color.

name: Maugle Sierra, St. Croix
review: I tried this wine at the winery in Ledyard CT. It was very spicey, with notes of blackberry and pepper. I was the only one of the group that liked this particular bottle.

name: Maugle Sierra, Rendezvous
review: I tried this wine at the winery in Ledyard CT. This was a great white wine with notes of peach and apricot. This wine was a mix of Chardonnay and Riesling grapes. This bottle was the favorite among the group.

name: Maugle Sierra, 1740 Ledyard House Rosé
review: I should have rated this wine lower. I found it boozy and had odd flavors.

name: Santa Maria La Palma, Aragosta Rosé
review: I paired this wine with homemade pasta and shrimp scampi. It was a really good bottle to add to the night. Semi-dry, and smooth.

name: Domaine Lafage, Novellum Chardonnay
review: This bottle was amazing. I had this while I was making a pasta dough. Dry, yellowish hue, refreshing wine.

name: Sea Sun, Pinot Noir
review: I tried this wine at a good friend's wedding. It was a great wine for the occasion. The wine had fruity aromas with plum, cherry, and strawberry notes.

name: Wycliff, Brut
review: Another wine from the wedding. This one was good, notably fruity, Great for an $8 bottle of wine.

name: Ferrari Carano, Tré Terre Chardonnay
review: Another wine from the wedding. This was the best white wine of the bunch. Apple and pear aromas, full bodied, long finish.

name: La Marca, Prosecco
review: Final wine from the wedding. This was an okay wine, there wasn't anything notable about it. Fizzy, citrus

name: High Table, Cabernet Sauvignon
review: This was a good wine for the price ($7.99). Oaky, blackberry, and cherry notes. Classic table wine.

name: Masi, Campofiorin
review: I had this wine in the North End of Boston. It was a good wine - deep ruby, tobacco and cherry.

name: Isaac Fernandez, Biutiful Cava Brut Rosé
review: I had this Rosé with red wine infused turkey and champagne mashed potatoes. It was a very nice pairing. Slightly fizzy, and slightly acidic. Flavors of cherry, strawberry, and raspberry.

name: Butternut, Cabernet Sauvignon
review: Sort of earthy, light, smooth, medium-dry wine

name: Acinum, Prosecco Extra Dry
review: Acidic, fizzy, and light prosecco. Very crisp and enjoyable.

name: Isaac Fernandez, Biutiful Cava Brut Nature
review: This was a good wine but did not pair well with the shrimp cocktail.

name: Meadowcroft, Cabernet Sauvignon
review: This was a great bottle and a great gift from my brother. Earthy, blackberry. Paired with homemade meatball and it was very good.

name: Chateau d'Esclans, Whispering Angel Rosé
review: Not a bad bottle of wine. Dry, white.

name: Cigar Box, Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
review: This bottle was not good. Of all 4 people drinking this wine, no one wanted to finish the glass. Dry, bold, and tobacco.
